baselines.name: kivi_overlap_4bit
baselines.notes: KIVI-style K4/V4 adaptation with key per-channel, value per-token, group size 32, key block-modulo residual blocks, and value tail residual length 128.

baselines.name: kvtuner4_pertoken_qwen25_3b
baselines.notes: KVTuner official Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct_pertoken_KVTuner4_0 per-layer preset implemented in AdaptiveKVQuantizer with the signed-asymmetric vanilla formula, axis_key=0, axis_value=0, q_group_size=-1, residual_length=0.

baselines.name: kvtuner4_kivi_qwen25_3b
baselines.notes: KVTuner official Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct_kivi_KVTuner4_0 per-layer preset implemented in AdaptiveKVQuantizer with the signed-asymmetric vanilla formula, axis_key=1, axis_value=0, q_group_size=32, residual_length=32 with block-modulo residuals.

baselines.name: squat_subspace_4bit
baselines.notes: SQuat LongBench-style 4-bit configuration implemented in AdaptiveKVQuantizer with prefill query SVD, future-dimension key correction, subspace_dim=60, squat_lambda=0.001, quant_group_size=64, shared_svd=true, K/V group size 32, and residual block length 32.
